where: The Old Light, top — The Winding Room (Mr. Punchwheel, the great joke-drum, flying apart)
mood: The Winding Room — the joke machine at full delirium: the march in every key at once, lurching, melting, and snapping back.
_note: R11 pass 2: the MOST broken rung, past F6's stuck record: the whole machine flying apart, polytonal clashes, lurching tempo feel, melting pitch, every two bars a new key, then the spring snaps it back. 126 grid, double-time feel. Never name the tune or mention the reference.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
126 BPM with a frantic double-time feel
the march in two clashing keys at once, brass a semitone apart
4/4 that lurches, rushing and dragging every phrase
steam calliope and brass band playing the march
melting pitch slides like a warped record
jumps to a new key every two bars
clockwork ratchets, bicycle horns, slide whistles and crashing cymbals
a spring boing that snaps everything back to F
delirious, unhinged, joyous chaos, a joke machine coming apart
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a wind-up key cranks and jams, then the whole band bursts in at once in two clashing keys}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the tower's march tune at a double-time gallop on calliope and brass, the brass a semitone apart, jumping to a new key every two bars, ratchets speeding up}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {again even wilder: the tempo lurches between rushing and dragging, pitch melting down then shooting up, bicycle horns and slide whistles on every beat}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the joke-drum spins out, a whirling waltz-time lurch with cymbal crashes, the tune shattering into fragments in every key, then one huge spring boing}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the march crashes back in F at full gallop, still clashing; the last bar's spring boing snaps straight back to the top of the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
